auditLimitations: All74 actual registry entries, source-confirmed parsed semantics and known panel actions are enumerated. Implementation status and behavior receipts remain separate; source audit completeness does not claim functional parity. Concurrent source edits invalidate their recorded subject hashes.
Source hashes include shipped TUI/parser definitions; changes require re-audit. No behavior proof is inferred from enum membership, file existence, top-level availability or test filenames.

Stored policy/credential/standing automation mutations and frozen review/governance mutation scope are explicit boundaries; workspace/product are read-only data/navigation, not invented mutation gaps.
Current local capability absence remains a setup requirement; production bindings and passing exact-variant evidence are still required before release.

Task 19: required status and pins are derived from executed receipts (scripts/verify-native-coverage.ts): each variant runs through the local terminal adapter and the headless host of a production-assembled native runtime in an isolated synthetic-config child. The subject has no machine-bridge lifecycle, Hub project-context, MCP, bus, rewind or Jev owners, so those rows refuse on both paths and stay required gaps. The expectedVariants parser audit itself is not re-derived from TUI source; catalogue-advertised nested actions are checked automatically.
